question.question:
Apply only this fictional scenario-local compliance policy. A firm has 25 open audit findings. Remediation cost is tiered: each of the first 25 findings costs 1200 USD; each finding beyond the first 25 costs 2600 USD. If the firm has 25 or fewer findings, only the first tier applies. Gross cost is the sum of both tiers. An early-closure credit of 500 USD per finding is earned for the 1 findings closed early, giving an uncapped credit. The applied credit is the uncapped credit capped at 20 percent of gross cost, and it is granted only when gross cost is at least 45000 USD; if gross cost is below 45000 USD the applied credit is zero. Net remediation cost equals gross cost minus the applied credit. Report gross cost, uncapped credit, applied credit, and net cost.

Answer format: use exact arithmetic through all intermediate steps, round only the final value half up to 2 decimal digits, and return only the numeric value interpreted in `usd` with no unit label or additional text.

slots.description: Gross tiered remediation cost before any credit.
Early-closure credit before applying cap or threshold.
Credit actually applied after cap and threshold gating.
